summary: Backend-only testing for PMR Digital Marketing Agency API. Wrote comprehensive pytest suite covering auth (login/logout/me/brute-force), leads (public submit, RBAC, stage validation, convert idempotency), clients (CRUD + client-role isolation), projects (status/progress), tasks (status update + recalculation), overview (staff vs client), CMS (blog/portfolio/testimonials draft-vs-publish filters), services (seeded >=9), invoices (server-side total computation + sequential numbering), payments (status transitions partially_paid -> paid), client invoice isolation, client portal overview, and user RBAC (admin-only create + super_admin-only deactivate). All 28 tests passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: Lead convert does not create a lead_activity record (minor; audit log would be helpful)
Non-admin/finance/sales staff (project_manager/employee/marketing_executive) get 403 on GET /api/invoices (hard-coded role list). Fine per RBAC spec but worth documenting.
Cookies use SameSite=None; Secure=True which is appropriate for cross-origin, but means local non-HTTPS clients cannot rely on cookies (Bearer header still works).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1255 lines (single-file). Recommend splitting into routers (auth, leads, clients, projects, tasks, cms, invoices, portal) and models/ module for maintainability.
Brute-force identifier is IP:email; behind an ingress all clients may share an IP making legitimate users easier to lock out. Consider using email-only or hashed email + IP window with sliding reset.

Password reset tokens stored with datetime object (not iso string) while most datetimes are stored as ISO strings. The TTL index on expires_at only works if value is BSON Date (ok as-is for insert_one), but mixed types in codebase is error-prone.
reset_password datetime comparison line 445 has a nested conditional that can mis-handle naive datetimes; prefer explicit normalization before comparison.
Invoice _compute_invoice_totals mutates list items in place; fine but worth noting.
No pagination on list endpoints (.to_list(500/1000)) - will not scale with growth.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec; browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard. Needs explicit origin in CORS_ORIGINS for production.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_-prefixed leads/clients/projects/tasks/blog/portfolio/testimonials/invoices/users via APIs. No manual DB seeding required - backend seeds admin + demo users + services at startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green on first iteration. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_pmr_backend.py as regression suite. Note: brute-force test leaves a locked identifier (TEST_bf_* email + container IP) in db.login_attempts for 15 min - benign. CORS wildcard+credentials should be addressed before shipping to production domains.
